thesisQuality.basis: Customer Daimler confirms long-range LiDAR selection and Bendix-parent confirms active-safety development, supporting a real commercial thesis; design/program milestones are not realized scaled economics.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: 2026 Q2 SEC/issuer evidence supports improved liquidity alongside continuing operating losses and financing dependence; pricing-concession exposure makes durable margin improvement unproven.

catalystScore.basis: Customer-announced 2026 Aeva start and 2027 Daimler ramp plus Atlas C samples and LG Innotek 2027/2028 roadmap provide dated catalysts, but milestones remain forward-looking without realized unit volumes.

governancePower.basis: July 2026 Schedule 13D/A reports Sylebra affiliates 29.3% beneficial ownership on diluted Rule 13d-3 basis, including unconverted notes, and expired standstill; neither proves current votes nor board control.

alignment2036.basis: Long-range autonomous-truck sensing, traffic intelligence and short-range physical-world sensing align with safer mobility and infrastructure, while deployment economics remain unproven.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: LiDAR perception and DSP capabilities span automotive, traffic and industrial sensing use cases, indicating possible platform reuse; no evidence yet proves material cross-segment contribution.

bottleneckControl.basis: Aeva's long-range FMCW role is customer-confirmed and optical integration is partner-corroborated, but Daimler/Torc's separate Innoviz short-range award bounds control over the overall sensor stack.

scenarioRobustness.basis: The roadmap depends on production qualification, manufacturing cost-down and customer conversion; current loss/financing exposure and competing architecture scope weaken downside robustness.

substitutionResilience.basis: Customer validation and partner optical integration support differentiated long-range utility, but Innoviz's separate selection illustrates competing LiDAR supply and sensor substitution/scope risk.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Named LG Innotek manufacturing roadmap, Cadence DSP license and Wideye integration corroborate ecosystem support; scale yields, cost-down and committed supply volumes remain undisclosed.

pricingPower.basis: Aeva's SEC filing explicitly warns of volume/strategic-customer discounts that may not be offset by lower manufacturing costs, with no demonstrated ASP escalators or realized pricing power.

commercializationAndFinancingRisk.basis: High risk from operating losses, possible dilution, production-conversion uncertainty, margin concessions and limited customer sensor scope; risk score is an Alpha assessment, not canonical math. June 2026 preliminary prospectus further documents outstanding and potential dilution buckets; not an issuer-certified current fully diluted capitalization.

sourceAddressedUnderwritingConfidence.basis: Multiple independent customer/partner and SEC sources corroborate program, governance and financing facts, but absent specialist source-integrity coverage and undisclosed realized economics constrain confidence. Preliminary prospectus improves traceability of dilution inputs but does not establish current share count, enterprise value, or a forward valuation denominator.

sourceEvidenceInputs.basis: June 4 preliminary SEC 424B5 reports 62,984,603 basic common shares as of March 31, 2026, excluding 2,307,265 option shares, 6,098,455 RSUs, 735,294 performance RSUs, 1,897,916 later RSU grants, 1,599,770 later performance RSU grants and 3,000,000 Series A warrant shares.
